About Us.

dentalpro. by IMPLANET
The official online store of IMPLANET Dental Implant Systems, a manufacturer-direct eCommerce platform for dental professionals worldwide. Shop implant systems and prosthetic components compatible with major brands.

One Stop Shop
Your source for premium dental implants, prosthetic parts, and surgical tools with customized production services from design to delivery.

One Mission
To exceed expectations every day.
delivering reliable, premium-quality implant products with fast service and cost-effective solutions tailored for dental professionals.

Tailored Made Solutions.

Tailored OEM CNC & Implant System Production

At IMPLANET, we provide customized OEM solutions for dental implants and prosthetic components.

Customized CNC Manufacturing

High Precision: Titanium Grade 23 ELI and medical-grade stainless steel parts manufactured with micron-level accuracy.

Flexible Production: From single-unit prototypes to large-scale mass production.

Design Support: CAD/CAM engineering assistance to refine your concept into a final product.

Complete Finishing: Sandblasting, acid-etching, anodizing , and final clean room packaging.
